description: This is a C++ source file implementing the FrontPanel plugin for a media or set-top box system. It provides a JSON-RPC interface for controlling front panel indicators, LEDs, clock display patterns, and preferences. The file includes registration of API methods, event handling, and internal logic for managing front panel hardware features.

classes.name: FrontPanel
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing the front panel control, exposing JSON-RPC methods for external interaction, handling hardware events, and managing LED and display states.

classes.name: TestPatternInfo
classes.description: Helper class used for timing and scheduling periodic updates of the LED text pattern.

methods.name: setBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC call to set the brightness of a specified front panel indicator.

methods.name: getBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC call to get the brightness of a specified front panel indicator.

methods.name: powerLedOnWrapper
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC call to turn on a specified front panel LED.

methods.name: powerLedOffWrapper
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC call to turn off a specified front panel LED.

methods.name: setClockBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC call to set clock display brightness.

methods.name: getClockBrightnessWrapper
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC call to get clock display brightness.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLightsWrapper
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC call to get list of controllable front panel lights.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLightsInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about each front panel light including supported ranges, colors, and modes.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets properties such as brightness and color for a specific LED.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for an LED.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Queries whether the system is in 24-hour clock mode.

methods.name: setClockTestPattern
methods.description: Enables or disables the test pattern on the clock display (88:88).

methods.name: updateLedTextPattern
methods.description: Updates the LED text display with a pattern, scheduled periodically.
